title: print: in the dark theme with background graphics on, the @page margin band prints dark (color-scheme: dark canvas has no print colour)
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pmEYLVFDcQ1Z1CS8H

Filing gate: ① a user-visible defect with a named cause. Found while reviewing PR #34422 (#34228, print layout). It is present both before and after that PR (heads `cfcba539` and `98f29438`), so it is not introduced by it.

`reach:` measured in a scratch harness with the console's compiled CSS in Chromium (dev report 6925134613, the R3 item under #34228). It has NOT yet been reproduced with Ctrl+P in a running console. The first acceptance item does that.

## What happens

With the console in the dark theme and "Background graphics" turned on in the print dialog, the 12 mm `@page` margin band prints dark, rgb(18, 18, 18). The cause: `.dark { color-scheme: dark }` turns the root canvas dark, and no print rule colours the page-margin area. The printed record content itself is unaffected, with black text on white.

## Expected

A printed page has a white margin whatever theme the console is in, like the content area that #34228 already prints on white.

## Acceptance

1. Reproduce it in a running console: dark theme, Ctrl+P, background graphics on.
2. Fix it in the print stylesheet, for example `color-scheme: light` and a white canvas under `@media print`. Pin it with the same harness, plus a light-theme control.

Duplicate check: `is:issue is:open print dark theme margin` found no match.
